question: _________ is the use of government expenditure and tax policies to influence economic conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Fiscal Policy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fiscal Policy is the use of government expenditure and tax policies to influence economic conditions.**
 
• **Fiscal policy:**
 
 
• It refers to the use of government spending and tax policies to influence economic conditions, especially macroeconomic conditions, including aggregate demand for goods and services, employment, inflation, and economic growth.
